title: 第二十五章 被诅咒的血脉第二十六章 疗伤
content_zh:
大殿中，灯火通明，放眼看去不仅给人一种气势磅礴的感觉，更是让人有一种进入了神圣殿堂的感觉。
“别愣在那里了，过来吧？”
这个时候，位于大殿中央位置的一具水晶石棺中传来先前那神秘男子的声音。对于石棺里竟然会传出声音，武书内心是相当困惑的。
正常来说，棺材这种东西，只是人族死者的安息之所，常人在活着的时候，没有几人愿意躺在棺材里。要说有这种人，那也是人族中的异类。
武书是不会相信自己的祖上，会有这种异类的，武书更愿相信，水晶石棺中躺着的就是魔族老祖。
而就在武书心中疑惑重重时，神识里的武左道，“这……这一切是真的吗？眼前这座大殿就是不老殿，整座大殿都是由不老石打造而成。”
武右则是应声道，“不老殿啊？作为镇嶽大殿中最神秘的组成部分之一，即便是凡胎肉体生活在其中，也能永生，遗忘大陆早已支离破碎，没想到不老殿还完好在此。”
镇嶽大殿这个名字，武书并不是第一次听说，殿主天生祖体，先天神王巅峰实力，出生即拥有一人足以睥睨天下的实力。只是，这个所谓的不老殿，武书却是第一次进入。
而一个能让凡人长生不老的地方，真是值得世间众人争夺的至宝啊？
如此至宝竟然就在眼前，而且还独属于眼前水晶石棺中的中年人。眼前男子要真是武家先祖，能够将如此至宝据为己有，当年他的实力要达到何种地步？
当然，要是眼前水晶石棺中躺着的是魔族老祖，武书也算是太倒霉了。
“哈哈哈……”
就在武书愣神的时候，夜行兽竟然仰天大笑起来，竟还是口吐人言道，“不老石？真的是不老石啊？哈哈……真是老天都不愿亡我。”
夜行兽会有此举，简直是惊呆了水晶石棺中的中年男子。
水晶石棺中传来冰冷的声音，“何方宵小？竟敢到此撒野？”
夜行兽就像成精了一样，不急不慢的道，“武氏三祖，雷祖，烈祖，战祖，当年即便我魔族至高老祖，与三位相遇时，都是不得不谨慎应对。没想到，万年之后，至高老祖依旧健在，而武氏三祖中，却仅剩流淌我魔族血脉的战祖，在此苟延残喘的活着。”
能够知道当年那些陈年旧事的，来者在魔族中的地位必然是不低的。当年，不说大哥二哥，身负魔族血脉的武战在魔族之中就是干了不少惊天动地的事情，武战都记不清楚，曾经有多少魔族天骄死在自己的手里。
就算来者是魔族之人，武战依旧冷静道，“尔等鼠辈，能够来到此处，想来也是很不易。”
夜行兽一副得意忘形道，“哈哈哈……，能够来到此地的确不易，能够来到这里，我可要好好感谢你们武家的这位小辈。要是没有他的帮助，要是他没有决定带着这头蠢驴一同前来，我都不知道该如何进入到此地。”
水晶石棺里的中年男子如今身体状况的确是不佳的，但他却是很清楚的，魔族中人能够神不知鬼不觉得出现在这里，自身实力肯定是不弱的。像武书这种小辈，就算是在同辈中实力超群，遇到这些魔族老怪物，也只是没成长起来的天才罢了。

武战沉声道，“小辈，等下我会出手阻止这个魔物，石棺中有你需要的东西。”
被魔族附体的夜行兽讥笑道，“天昏地暗，无迹可寻，当属我夜魔一族，今日你们都会死在这里，能死在我音无伤手里，你们应该感到庆幸。”
来者竟然是音无伤，武战强压住内心的惊异道，“原来你就是夜魔老祖音无伤？”
水晶石棺中的中年人竟然知道自己的名字，音无伤无比自豪道，“战祖，是不是感到非常意外？夜魔一族有人能够冲破你们人族的诅咒，又出现了一位老祖。”
能够成长为老祖级的实力，想到这件事，音无伤是感到无比自豪的。而此刻，在音无伤看来，武战武书二人一个是残废，一个是不成气候的小辈，都是俎上鱼肉罢了。音无伤又是道，“说起被诅咒这事，你们武家会有如今下场，还真是要感谢黑魔神。若非当年黑魔神的分身在陨落时，以燃烧分身神念下的血脉诅咒，如今的武家，怕是早已成为厚土大陆上的最强家族之一了。”
说完这些后，在夜行兽身体中的音无伤又是仰天大笑，“哈哈哈……，一个人不管他实力有多么强大，要是他只有实力没有清醒的头脑，就算他拥有永生的躯体，他也终将灭亡。千不该万不该，你们不该招惹黑魔神。”
content_en:
In the main hall, the lights are brightly lit. Looking at it not only gives people a majestic feeling, but also makes people feel like they have entered a sacred hall.
"Stop standing there and come over here?"
At this time, the voice of the mysterious man from before came from a crystal sarcophagus located in the center of the hall. Wu Shu was quite confused about the sound coming from the sarcophagus.
Normally, coffins are only the resting place for the dead of the human race. When ordinary people are alive, few people are willing to lie in coffins. If there is such a person, he is an outlier among the human race.
Wu Shu would not believe that his ancestors could have such aliens. Wu Shu would rather believe that the person lying in the crystal sarcophagus was the ancestor of the demon clan.
Just when Wu Shu was filled with doubts, Wu Zuo said in his spiritual consciousness, "Is this... is all this true? The hall in front of you is the Hall of Immortality, and the entire hall is made of the Immortal Stone."
Wu You responded, "The Temple of Eternal Life? As one of the most mysterious components of Zhenyue Hall, even a mortal body living in it can live forever. The Forgotten Continent has long been fragmented, but I didn't expect that the Temple of Eternal Age is still intact here."
This is not the first time that Wu Shu has heard of the name Zhenyue Hall. The master of the hall is born with the ancestral body and the peak strength of the innate god king. He has the strength from birth to be enough for one person to look down on the world. However, it was the first time for Wu Shu to enter this so-called Hall of Immortality.
And a place that allows mortals to live forever, is it really a treasure worth fighting for in the world?
Such a treasure is actually right in front of you, and it belongs exclusively to the middle-aged man in the crystal sarcophagus in front of you. If the man in front of me is really the ancestor of the Wu family and can take such a treasure as his own, what level of strength would he have reached back then?
Of course, if the person lying in the crystal sarcophagus in front of him was the ancestor of the demon clan, Wu Shu would be very unlucky.
"Hahaha..."
Just when Wu Shu was stunned, the night beast looked up to the sky and laughed, and still uttered human words, "The Stone of Agelessness? Is it really the Stone of Agelessness? Haha... God doesn't want to kill me."
The middle-aged man in the crystal sarcophagus was simply shocked by what Night Beast Club did.
A cold voice came from the crystal sarcophagus, "Who is Xiaoxiao? How dare you act wild here?"
The night beast seemed to have become a spirit, and said in a leisurely manner, "The three ancestors of the Wu family, the Lei ancestor, the Lie ancestor, and the Zhan ancestor. Even my demon clan's supreme ancestor had to be cautious when meeting these three. Unexpectedly, ten thousand years later, the supreme ancestor is still alive, but among the three Wu clan ancestors, only the Zhan ancestor who has the blood of my demon clan is left alive here."
Those who can know those old events from back then must have a high status in the demon clan. Back then, not to mention his eldest and second brothers, Wu Zhan, who had the blood of the Demon Clan, did a lot of earth-shattering things among the Demon Clan. Wu Zhan couldn't even remember how many of the Demon Clan's geniuses had died in his own hands.
Even if the visitor is a member of the demon clan, Wu Zhan still said calmly, "It's not easy for you rats to come here."
Nightwalker said with a complacency, "Hahaha... It's really not easy to come here. For being able to come here, I have to thank this junior of your Wu family. Without his help, if he didn't decide to bring this stupid donkey with him, I don't know how I would have entered this place."
The middle-aged man in the crystal sarcophagus is indeed in poor physical condition now, but he knows very well that if the demons can appear here without knowing anything, their own strength must not be weak. A junior like Wu Shu, even if he is outstanding among his peers, is just a genius who has not grown up when encountering these old demon monsters.
Wu Zhan said in a deep voice, "Junior, I will take action to stop this monster later. There is something you need in the sarcophagus."
The night beast possessed by the demons sneered, "The sky is dark and the earth is dark, there is no trace.Ke Xun, you belong to my Night Demon clan. You will all die here today. You should feel lucky to die in the hands of my Yin Wushang. "
The visitor turned out to be Yin Wushang, Wu Zhan suppressed his inner surprise and said, "So you are the Night Demon Ancestor Yin Wushang? "
The middle-aged man in the crystal sarcophagus actually knew his name, Otonashi said with great pride, "Zhan Ancestor, are you very surprised? Someone in the Night Demon clan can break the curse of your human race, and another ancestor has appeared. "
Being able to grow into ancestor-level strength, thinking about this, Otonashi feels extremely proud. At this moment, in Yin Wushang's opinion, one of Wu Zhan and Wu Shu was a disabled person, and the other was an unworthy junior. They were nothing more than meat and potatoes. Otonashi said again, "Speaking of being cursed, you, the Wu family, have to thank the Dark Lord for your current fate. If it hadn't been for the blood curse that burned the clone's spiritual thoughts when the Black Demon God's clone fell, the Wu family today would probably have become one of the strongest families in the thick earth continent. "
After saying this, Otonashi, who was in the body of the night beast, looked up to the sky and laughed again, "Hahaha..., no matter how powerful a person is, if he only has strength and no clear mind, even if he has an immortal body, he will eventually perish. Absolutely no, you should not provoke the Dark Lord. "
